name: B004 openGauss数据库查询
setup: CREATE TABLE Categories (CategoryID SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, CategoryName VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE products (ProductID SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, ProductName VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, CategoryID INTEGER, SupplierID INTEGER, UnitPrice money DEFAULT 0, UnitsInStock INTEGER DEFAULT 0, ReorderLevel INTEGER DEFAULT 0, Discontinued INTEGER NOT NULL);

commands: \c dbtrade

steps.caption: 查看 products 表中的数据
commands: SELECT * FROM products;

steps.caption: CROSS JOIN 交叉连接查询
commands: SELECT * FROM Categories CROSS JOIN products;

steps.caption: INNER JOIN 内连接查询
commands:
SELECT * FROM Categories a INNER JOIN products b 
ON a.CategoryID = b.CategoryID;

steps.caption: LEFT OUTER JOIN 左外连接查询
commands:
SELECT * FROM Categories a LEFT OUTER JOIN products b 
ON a.CategoryID = b.CategoryID;

steps.caption: RIGHT OUTER JOIN 右外连接查询
commands:
SELECT * FROM Categories a RIGHT OUTER JOIN products b 
ON a.CategoryID = b.CategoryID;

steps.caption: FULL OUTER JOIN 全外连接查询
commands:
SELECT * FROM Categories a FULL OUTER JOIN products b 
ON a.CategoryID = b.CategoryID;

steps.caption: 子查询：单独执行被嵌入的查询
commands: SELECT CategoryID FROM Categories b WHERE b.CategoryName = '休闲食品';

steps.caption: 子查询：执行完整查询语句
commands:
SELECT * 
FROM products a 
WHERE a.CategoryID IN 
(SELECT CategoryID 
FROM Categories b 
WHERE b.CategoryName = '休闲食品') ;

steps.caption: 查看 Categories 表结构
commands: \d Categories

steps.caption: 为 CategoryName 创建唯一索引
commands: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX Category_Name ON Categories (CategoryName);

steps.caption: 查看表结构，确认索引已创建
commands: \d Categories

steps.caption: 删除索引
commands: DROP INDEX Category_name;

steps.caption: 创建视图 SE_products
commands: CREATE VIEW SE_products AS SELECT * FROM products WHERE CategoryID = 1;

steps.caption: 查询视图中的数据
commands: SELECT * FROM SE_products;

steps.caption: 删除视图
commands: DROP VIEW SE_products;
